snippet.title: Trenchhold TD – Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Trenchhold TD on Steam! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3343280/Trenchhold_TD/?utm_source=youtube

Trenchhold TD is an incremental tower defense game set on the battlefields of World War I. Hold your trenches against thousands of enemies, upgrade your forces, and launch full-scale counter-attacks to crush their defenses!

#towerdefense #incrementalgame #strategygames #strategygaming
